Location: FKiSS Actions > letset

Action: Letset(variable)

Related Actions: changecol, changeset, letpal, letcatch
Related Events: set
See also: FKiSS, Events, Actions

letset(variable)

First defined in: FKiSS3
The letset action sets the value of variable to the current set (page).

variable

variable must be a variable name.

Example:

;@ letset(S) ; Set variable S to the number of the current set.
